rows.grounds: instrumental plural of compound sita+amala+jala (white, spotless, water); sandhi ś before ca
adverb indicating continuation in the same manner
instrumental singular of compound koṣṇa+udaka (lukewarm water)

items.question: Which additional liquids are prescribed for bathing the deity in this ritual sequence?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe bathing the deity with fragrant waters.
White, pure waters are specified as a bathing substance.
Lukewarm water is likewise specified as a bathing substance.
items.inference: The ritual bathing of the deity continues with white pure waters and likewise with lukewarm water.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function distinguishing these liquids from those in the preceding verses is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And indeed with white, pure waters, and likewise with lukewarm water.
